entries.label: t3code/main/client-environment-suite
entries.note: Continuation of the closed #9376 (and #4444, #4474, #4486, #4496, #4548, #4559, #4567). Builds on main's Local environment setting (#9194): an existing local server or --backend-mode overrides it for one launch so the desktop attaches instead of spawning a second backend. Discovery reads server-runtime.json and pairs through `t3 pair --json`. Environment-scoped settings were dropped when main shipped its settings scopes. Per-environment accent colors and display names (#4505, #4538) live on fork:t3code/environment-accent-and-names, which is not carried.
entries.summary: Client-only desktop, local server discovery and pairing

entries.label: t3code/main/client-storage-separation
entries.note: Built on #4437's split layout and must stay after it. In the legacy layout everything stays in ~/.t3/userdata; in split layout the client uses t3code-client XDG roots. --client-dir still relocates the desktop's own files in either layout.
entries.summary: Client storage separate from the server's T3 home, plus `t3 storage migrate`

entries.label: t3code/main/declarative-settings
entries.note: T3CODE_MANAGED_{SETTINGS,KEYBINDINGS,CLIENT_SETTINGS}_FILE override user values, render as managed in the UI, and reject writes. Stacked on shared-server-settings: defaults < shared < settings.json < managed. The Home Manager options live in the pr-4699 entry.
entries.summary: Nix-managed read-only settings, keybindings, and client settings layers

entries.label: t3code/main/mobile-tailscale-fleet
entries.note: Stacked on managed-fleet. `t3 auth enrollment export` writes one host's entry; a coordinator (dotfiles gen-gh-pages/t3code/mint-enrollment.sh) combines them. Mobile pairs every host concurrently with per-host results and retry. Fleet handoffs and server-advertised membership were removed. The Home Manager fleetManifest option (pr-4699) now only feeds the export.
entries.summary: Enroll a phone in every fleet host from one encrypted bundle
